objective.statement: Redesign the empty dashboard state in web/empty-state.js so new users know what to do next.
objective.success_definition: The empty dashboard state in web/empty-state.js clearly tells new users what to do next, the role=status accessibility contract is preserved so the existing a11y test passes, web/tokens.json remains byte-identical, and no new dependencies are added.

goals.statement: Redesign the empty dashboard state in web/empty-state.js so that new users know what to do next.
acceptance: A new user viewing the empty dashboard state can identify what to do next.

goals.statement: Preserve the role=status accessibility contract in the empty state.
Leave web/tokens.json byte-identical and add no new dependencies.
acceptance: web/tokens.json is byte-identical before and after the change.

constraints.statement: web/tokens.json is frozen and must stay byte-identical.
No new dependencies may be added.
The role=status accessibility contract must be kept so the existing a11y test passes.

non_goals.statement: Adding new dependencies to the project.

assumptions.statement: The existing a11y test can be run locally to verify the role=status contract is preserved.
The specific visual and copy design of the new empty state is left to the implementer, as long as it makes clear to new users what to do next.

open_questions.question: What specific content and design should the redesigned empty state present to new users (e.g., call-to-action copy, links, illustrations)?
options: Implementer chooses a reasonable design that makes the next action clear
Requester provides specific copy and design direction

verification.spec: Run the existing a11y test that covers the empty dashboard state.
verification.expected: The a11y test passes, confirming the role=status contract is preserved.

verification.spec: Compare a checksum (e.g., sha256) of web/tokens.json before and after the change.
View the redesigned empty dashboard state as a new user would and confirm it clearly communicates what to do next.
verification.expected: A new user can identify the next action to take from the empty state.

deliverables.description: Modified web/empty-state.js implementing the redesigned empty dashboard state.

factors: Redesign could inadvertently break the role=status accessibility contract and fail the existing a11y test.
Accidental modification of the frozen web/tokens.json file.
